name: PT Informasi Teknologi Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Informasi Teknologi Indonesia Tbk operates as a technology solutions company in Indonesia. The company operates through SMS Broadcast, Whatsapp, and Other Services segments. Its products portfolio includes WhatsApp Business API; BerandaToko, a chat commerce application; CPRO, a CRM system; Coster, a helpdesk ticketing system; Jessie, a chat commerce solution; SMS Broadcast, a SMS broadcast provider; email blast applications; automated chatbot support services using artificial intelligence (AI); SMS location-based advertising services; and mobile applications and systems development solutions.
